I'm looking at a licence register, so the question is whether "Business Name" refers to the licence holder. I'm leaning toward mapping it to legal_name at 0.7 confidence, though it could just as easily be a trading name.

I'm settling on trading_name at 0.55 for "Business Name", since the register doesn't label it as registered. For the status field, I'll map only Current to active and leave Expired out, because I can't tell whether an expired licence means deregistered.

I'm choosing Expired to map to unknown, since an expired licence isn't the same as a deregistered company. Next I'll validate the ABN, normalise the postcode, carry the state over as state_code, and send Suburb to address.locality. Licence Status describes the licence rather than the entity, so I'm leaning toward leaving it unmapped with a reason.
